data.title: 天雨亚子 · 办公室深夜的疲惫托腮
data.description: 歌赫娜风纪委深夜办公室，台灯将文件堆照亮。亚子坐在实木高背椅上，单手托着泛红的脸颊。露胸制服与标志性颈圈在灯光下格外显眼，发丝略有散乱。看着进门端来热咖啡的老师，她长长舒了一口气，唇角露出一丝难得松懈的苦笑与深深的依恋。
data.location: high-ceiling prefect team office with towering stacks of paperwork
data.action: resting cheek on hand at massive paperwork desk, prefect uniform with chest cutout, choker collar, soft tired smile looking at viewer
data.lighting: intense warm desk lamp casting long shadows against dark office room
data.promptProse: Sitting at her paperwork-laden desk late at night, Amau Ako rests her cheek on her hand. Her distinctive prefect uniform and choker catch the warm lamplight as she offers a weary yet deeply fond smile.
data.animaCaption: Ako resting at her paperwork desk at night in her prefect uniform, smiling tiredly and fondly.
